# Current customer mix

The paying customer base splits roughly into three groups: small pharmacies moving temperature-sensitive medication, a handful of specialty food producers, and a growing but still minority share of home-delivery subscriptions for a regional dairy. The dairy subscriptions are the newest segment and the fastest-growing of the three, up sharply over the past year, though still smaller in absolute revenue than the pharmacy contracts that anchor the business.

What the three groups actually have in common, once you set aside what they ship, is the job they are hiring the service for: none of them want to own and staff a cold chain themselves, because for each of them refrigerated logistics is a necessary cost of doing business rather than anything close to their core competence. The pharmacy owner said this almost word for word in a casual conversation last month, framing the service less as "delivery" and more as "the cold-chain expertise we didn't want to have to build in-house."
